entry.title: Retro Achievement Mastery 231 - Pokemon Mini Ambulation

link.title: Retro Achievement Mastery 231 - Pokemon Mini Ambulation

entry.content:
This one might take a little bit of explanation actually

First of all, what is a Pokemon Mini? Well, it was a tiny handheld game console made by Nintendo around the turn of the century that had a bunch of micro games on it. They’re mostly things like… Pokemon Zany Cards, which I’ve already mastered, and is just a collection of card games. It’s got like, just a beep sound effect, a very tiny screen (as you can see from the images I have from it), and no color. It is the most budget of budget consoles. But it’s a Pokemon product, so of course it was still a big deal.

And it gets homebrew.

Ambulation is a word meaning movement, essentially. And this is what this game is about. Ever play Frogger? Cause it’s just Frogger.

You have 8 characters to choose from, who play exactly the same but it’s cute to have a wide variety. Then you just… play endless frogger. You move up across moving platforms and dodging cars. As you move, it generates a new type of terrain at random. This means that you can be moving up and suddenly have three or four rivers in a row with lilypads, in which case, you are 100% fucked. That shit is evil.

Luckily the set doesn’t expect you to get very far. You need a score of 50 which is… fine.

Your choice of Pokemon to play as are genuinely nuts. And it’s also REALLY nuts, because two of the choices are MY TWO FAVORITE POKEMON. They’re not super popular mons, or very important in general, so it’s really weird. This is mainly the reason I played this, for the hubrice, the GUMPTION.

The 8 pokemon on display are Bulbasaur, Omanyte, Dragonair, Dunsparce, Nincada, Absol, Entei, and Regice. Dunsparce is my #2, Dragonair is my #1, just in case you were wondering. Not unloved by any means, but not exactly Charizard, are they?

And uh, that’s it. There’s like 3 different kinds of terrain, dirt, road, and river, play an endless mode of Frogger that kind of hates you. Look, it’s homebrew on the Pokemon Mini. This is basically whatcha get.

entry.title: Retro Achievement Mastery 233 - Pokemon Red Glitch Showcase

link.title: Retro Achievement Mastery 233 - Pokemon Red Glitch Showcase

entry.content:
Yes, I AM uploading three of these in one day. The faster I get through Pokemon February the better.

So yeah, I did Pokemon Red and then for some fucking reason IMMEDIATELY did it again, but this time I did the glitch showcase. So Retro Achievements has “subsets”, which basically sequester out the weird-ass achievements to their own sets. Around this time they had actually implemented the ability to play subsets at the same time as the main set, which was kinda why I jumped on Pokemon to test it out. But this wasn’t the best one for that, cause I wasn’t doing shit like this in the main game.

There are only 8 achievements in this set, and every one of them involves intensive glitching. I did a crash course on Pokemon gen 1 glitches for this, most of which I already knew, but some I needed a bit of a refresher. It’s always fun to do stuff like this, so let’s go into detail, since there’s only 8.

#1: Escaping the Simulation

Use the invisible PC in Celadon

In Celadon there’s a hotel that uses the same layout as a Pokemon center. When they copy and pasted the map, they removed the PC, but did not remove the invisible event tile. Whoopsies! I used to do this as a kid, it’s silly.

#2: Ya Dun Goofed

Find a way to crash the game

Extremely easy to do, honestly. You will probably do this one by accident while trying to do the following one.

#3: Speedrun?

Enter the Hall of Fame with 1 minute or less on the clock

I usually hate speedrun achievements. But for subsets, they’re fine, and for this one, it’s not really “hard” and very interesting. So, there’s a way to beat the game in less than a minute through Arbitrary Code Execution, or ACE. Basically the idea is you glitch the Pokemon and Item menus so you can pick up and drag code in the game around to where you want it to go, and that will activate the end game sequence. If you’re following a guide, it’s extremely easy to do, and if you want to do it fast, it takes the tiniest amount of memorization and will take you like 3 tries at most.

If you fuck it up you crash the game, so hey, that makes the previous achievement free!

#4: No Experience Necessary

Get the Pokemon in your first party slot from level 1 to level 100 in one battle

This one seems pretty wtf, but it’s not that bad if you get a glitched Pokemon through the Mew Glitch, which I’ll explain later on.

#5: Rare Candy Addiction

Stockpile 255 Rare Candies

The Missingno glitch is one of the most well known glitches of all time. You almost certainly know about it. If you talk to the old man, then fly to Cinnebar, and swim against the right side, it will summon glitch pokemon. One of these will increase the items in your 6th bag slot by 128. Simply have one rare candy there, glitch, then throw 2, then glitch again, and boom, you have 255. I’ve done this dozens of times honestly.

#6: Ruining the Neighborhood

Enter Glitch City by breaking the Safari Zone

Another one I did as a kid, this one is fun. To do this one, follow these instructions:

Go into the Safari Zone, pay the 500 to enter. Once you enter, turn back around and leave, then refuse to actually leave and re-enter. Once you’ve re-entered, turn back around and once again the attendant will ask you if you REALLY want to leave. Say no again. Then, save the game and restart the console.

When you start the game back up, try and leave again. This time, the attendant will NOT ask you if you want to leave, but instead if you want to enter. Refuse, and leave. Then go to any other map, walk around for the 500 steps, and boom, you’re in Glitch City.

It’s a real neat glitch. Just fly away to fix it.

#6: The Third Starter Wasn’t Alone

Defeat Professor Oak while he has the starter neither you nor your rival chose

In the game data is an unused trainer battle against Professor Oak in which he uses the unused starter evolution. This is a very high level trainer battle, higher than the champion, and seems like it was gonna be a cool bonus boss, but was sadly cut from the game. But we don’t have to put up with that.

The Mew Glitch is a very famous and very important glitch. By flying away at the same time you enter into a trainer’s field of view, you will enter a glitched state. If you then encounter a Pokemon as the most recent Pokemon you’ve seen, when you return to that original trainer’s location, you will get into a wild battle against a Pokemon based on that Pokemon’s stats.

https://puu.sh/257S This is a map of every trainer in the game and all the Pokemon you can find using the trainers. But sometimes, you gotta take matters into your own hands.

If you get a Pokemon with a special stat of exactly 226, you can encounter a ditto. Then, growl at it either 4 times for Charizard, 5 times for Venusaur, or 6 times for Blastoise. Then, return to the original trainer, and boom. Professor Oak.

This FEELS like a super intensive and complex glitch, and it’s certainly more so than the old man glitch, but it’s really shockingly easy to do. And if you know how to this glitch, you can….

#8: Catch ‘Em All - For Real This Time

Catch All 151 Pokemon

The implied sentence below this one is “without using the link cable”, because that is not allowed.

So yeah. Some Pokemon are not in this game. AND you’ll need to get Mew! What to do?! Well obviously, Mew Glitch. If you have that map, those special stats, and a lot of free time, you can do anything. ANYTHING.

So yeah, that’s a crash course on Pokemon gen 1 glitches. This is missing a lot of the other easier glitches, like using a Pokedoll to skip the ghost tower, but that’s fine. It’s just a crash course. I find this kinda thing really fun to do, honestly. And hey, now you can easily do it, too!

entry.title: Retro Achievement Mastery 232 - Pokemon Blue
entry.content:
So like I had said, there was a pretty large gap for masteries for me. I mastered My QLDC Hack in November, then Ambulation in late February. Three months of basically nothing. With me finally returned to the world of achievements, I returned in a kind of wild way. I was really in the mood for some Pokemon.

The next four masteries are ALL Pokemon gen 1. If you’ve been keeping an eye on this series, you’ll note that this is not anything new. In November 2024, I decided I wanted to try a Professor Oak Challenge and beat Pokemon Blue in a very grindy way. Then, in April of 2025, I mastered Pokemon Red. Well, since then, they decided to make the different versions split into different sets, so I could go out of my way to master Red AND Blue, so I did. I mastered Blue.

This DOES mean I need to do a Pokemon Red Prof Oak Challenge sometime but uh, that’s like, 2028 Liz’s problem.

Pokemon is a game that- Oh who am I fucking kidding, you know what Pokemon is.

I’ll be honest, one of the reasons I haven’t been writing these reviews much lately is because I have nothing to say. I’VE ALREADY BASICALLY REVIEWED GEN 1 TWO TIMES BEFORE, AND I HAVE THREE MASTERIES TO TALK ABOUT IT AFTER THIS.

This set was a lot easier though, honestly, than Blue’s. And MUCH quicker. I finished it in 14 hours. Compare that to Red, which took me 19 hours. A lot of that was because Red had super grindy achievements, level based achievements, achievements for beating the elite four with specific loadouts of teams, SOLO running the Elite Four. Blue just has things like get all the items and beat all the trainers. Much more reasonable. (If you’re curious, the Professor Oak’s Challenge took me 25 hours to finish. I have played too much gen 1. It’s NOT EVEN MY FAVORITE GEN.)

Also important to note, I could just glitch, and I did. Infinite items, here I come!

It sure is Pokemon. Time to talk about it a lot more.

entry.title: LizstarTrek - Prodigy Season 1 Episodes 11 - 20
entry.content:
Every Sunday my Twitch subs and I watch Star Trek in my Discord. Here are my reviews and thoughts on each of the episodes as I see it. If you’re curious about a nerd’s views on Star Trek episodes, please read on, I go quite in depth with some of these episodes! I’ve watched some Star Trek before but not all of it!

This is an interesting one. Fully 3D animated, so the third animated Trek show, and Trek does quite well in animation, though it’s never been 3D. This one is ALSO… for kids! That’s not a bad thing. Some of the best shows of all time are for kids. I don’t expect this to be like, Avatar or Gravity Falls levels, but I expect this to be the real last bright spot in the Trek ouvre.

Asylum - PRO 7/10

The crew are trying to sneak around on a planet and stop some poachers from killing Space Whales, while obeying the Prime Directive, which they 100% fail at cause Gwyn is having some PTSD visions about not needing to go. But they BARELY succeed and approeach the closest Federation comm relay station, asking them to pls don’t be upset that they stole their starship.

The only Federation person on the station is a Denobulan. Neat! He’s a friendly guy who’s anxious cause he’s cooped up in the furthest reaches of Federation space. He checks them all in, says they’ll be allowed in the Federation no problem, scans them, aaaand Dal is labeled as the alien species known as “IMMEDIATELY REPORT TO STARFLEET COMMAND”. Uh oh. Well hey, they know what he is! They do NOT know why Gwyn is, mind you.

Some kind of virus in the ship makes the base go nuts. Gwyn is nearby killed in a med pod. The Denobulan assumes they did this which like, good guess I guess, as the station tries to blow itself up. He takes the only escape pod and leaves these literal children to die. The federation’s finest :)

Ooh, another one of these gifs.

They go space walking and jump to the ship, which is wild. They barely make it cause Janeway tractors them in (tractor beam is shockingly kind on the body), as Gwyn remembers everything. That only took one episode!

Meanwhile, REAL Janeway makes it to the prison planet and finds the Diviner. Still alive, but barely. Yeah they were just gonna let that guy die.

Let Sleeping Borg Lie - PRO 3/10

Everyone watches the holodeck playback. I dunno why they didn’t do that already. Zero has panics about his being a weapon, as they all try and hunt for where the Diviner’s weapon is. They find it in a hidden subdeck on the bridge.

They find the weapon, which is some kinda future thing that protects itself and can’t be stopped, or turned off, seemingly. They then run into a Borg cube and Dal decides they’re going to fucking board it. Why? Cause they might find something in their systems to turn off the weapon. Man, there’s a lot of moments in this show where children do something stupid that’d easily get them killed but we know it’ll be fine cause it’s a kids show.

Meanwhile, Janeway is still trying to wake up the Diviner.

This Borg Cube has been brought to you by Xbox.

Dal, for SOME REASON, comes to the conclusion that they need to force assimilate one of their own to gain access to their systems and learn about the weapon. This is stupid as hell. Why is this guy captain? Zero volunteers, and the Borg IMMEDIATELY wake up. Cause yeah, obviously that’d wake them up. They very quickly just fucking abandon Zero and run away, and we get a Borg scene where they slowly walk towards them as they fight them off at a distance. The Borg are just fucking zombies now. I hate it. They’ve never felt like more zombies than now, and I saw Star Trek First Contact.

Do you think Murf can be assimilated?

They all get captured, because of course they do, as assimilated Zero starts to assimilate them as the other Borg just hold them for some reason. We have a “you’re still in there somewhere!” speech and the power of friendship overcomes the Borg assimilation and Zero knocks all the Borg out.

There’s also some stuff about “I hurt others in the past, now I will help” and it doesn’t really resonate, unfortunately. Also they learn NOTHING. The weapon cannot be stopped or shut down.

This episode was weirdly annoying, and had some dumb lines. The Borg clearly don’t work well in kids shows.

All the World’s a Stage - PRO 8/10

The crew gets a distress call and goes to check it out. There’s some interference, they can’t see what’s going on, but go down and fiiiind

James T and Soo’lu. They’re with the Fed’ration and are very excited to see their distress beacon. They are basically playing cosplay dressup, but slightly mangled. This is wild. Starfleet needs a Galaxy Quest protocol.

They basically worship Starfleet, and especially their bravest warrior, En’son the Red Shirted. They worship a redshirt who went down to help them out. They believe a prophecy that Starfleet will come back and save them from some nebulous threat, The Gallows. Dal thinks this is stupid as hell, and it kinda is. He’s like “these people are living a lie. Just like us.” so that’s the theme of this episode.

Dal gets infected, and they need to go to The Gallows to find a cure.

There’s some good stuff about “obviously we’re not Starflight. Duh. We don’t have starships or technology. But you don’t need those things to believe in what it stands for.” I like that.

Turns out “The Gallows” was actually “The Galileo”. Fucking GALILEO, AGAIN. EVEN NOW, HUNDREDS OF YEARS LATER, IT BOTHERS US. It’s been leaking warp fuel and causing miasma.

They need crew members to run the ship for a bit and save the others/fix the problem, and they beam the locals up to fly the ship, using holo emitters to make it seem like a 23rd century ship. It even has the noises! Thats cute. This was a good and cute episode. The usual “people influenced by the federation” but flips it into pretty good optimism.

Oh no. Murf is setting off my Tryptophobia ):

Crossroads - PRO 7/10

They decide to bury the Protostar on an ice planet and hitch a ride to the Federation instead.

They find a man and as for a ride. His name is… THADIUM OKONA. HOLY SHIT. YOU REMEMBER THAT GUY? He’s from “The Outrageous Okona”. He’s the Han Solo-ass mfer. He immediately gets

As they’re wandering around trying to find a ride, they keep running into Janeway’s crew. Dal basically sees as that fucking asshole from the other episode tells Janeway how they’re evil. Well great. Luckily, Janeway IMMEDIATELY goes “you forgot to mention they’re children.” so maybe she’ll be smart enough to see through this nonsense.

This base is run by Xindi Reptilians, which is neat.

They run away back to their ship. Janeway is like “oh I’m so happy to see you! How did your adventures go?” “Not great!” lol. Also Okona smuggled his way onboard basically and is with us.

Murf hatches, is now a marketable Minion-style character, aaaand leans on the console and shoots torpedos at them. Oops! They then flee into the Neutral zone at the suggestion of Okona. This guy is NOT a good role model. Janeway WANTS to follow but is stopped by Romulans who un-cloak in Federation space and go “HOW DARE YOU ALMOST ENTER THE NEUTRAL ZONE >:(“ MOTHER FUCKER, YOU’RE OUTSIDE OF IT. WHY ARE Y’ALL ALLOWED TO DO THAT? Cause the Federation is bad at negotations, I guess, wtf are they gonna do about the Romulans breaking the law? Declare war? The Romulans know it.

Masquerade - PRO 7/10

They need to go to a starport to repair the ship. Also everyone is immediately taking a shine to Okona…. except Dal. Everyone thinks he’s a cool swash buckling glub shitto, but Dal is daydreaming about spacing him. He convinces them to go to his “old stomping grounds”, a pirate haven basically. Oh boy I sure do trust this guy.

They have Murf in a baby bjorn. Thats cute.

They go to talk to a geneticist that Okona has connections to, and she immediately knows what Dal is. He’s not a species. He’s a Human Augment, created by the protoges of Arik Soong, the guy from Enterprise. He’s a Human Augment, like Khan. Yep. Plot twist, this is NOT the only show without a human protagonist, it has a human captain!!! Well, he’s also a bunch of other things. Some Vulcan, some Klingon

The geneticist says she can stabilize and improve his DNA. Everyone else is like “Dal you don’t need to be “fixed” that’s dumb” but he immediately goes for it.

While everyone is hanging out on the planet, the Tal Shiar sneak into the neutral zone because of fucking course they do, and try and capture the Protostar, they just need to capture Dal to get its command functions working.

Okona IMMEDIATELY dips as soon as the Tal Shiar show up. Everyone is like “how untrustworthy!” but I’mma be real, that’s the fair and normal reponse, honestly. He didn’t sign up to fight Romulan black ops. He didn’t sign up for anything! Dal tries to use his super mutant powers, beats them up for a second, but hten it goes out of control. He’s shifting into a billion different things, leaking goo, it’s gross. One Tal Shiar trips on the goo and falls. They do a “don’t worry, we can see his jetpack! He’s gonna be a-okay!” Oh also, Murf is their new security officer, he just beats the shit out of them.

Janeway is monitoring this from just outside the neutral zone and shoots some fucking torpedos at the Protostar to try and blow it up, juuuust as Murf beats the Tal Shiar. Oops! They manage to barely fix it, but her ensign watches evily. I don’t trust her.

Correctly. Turns out she’s ALSO Vau N’Akat, and is evil too! She makes another evil robot, too. God, we can’t get rid of that guy. Also this makes sense, she’s been consistently trying to push to get to the Protostar, her secret mission.

Preludes - PRO 7/10

We seem to have a mini clip show, all about the way the kids showed up at the jail.

Rok’s backstory is she played a monster for a guy’s circus troop, basically. She liked it at first, but didn’t like being seen as a big scary monster. Eventually she got fed up, then sold into slavery.

Zero’s is a lot more simple. She was just captured by slavers. He was living normally and happily with friends, then shoved in a box.

We also get the Diviner’s backstory, as this new girl tells him his backstory. The Protostar fell through a temporal anomaly into the future. Aaaand Chakotay sent it back into the anomaly without his crew. Why did he do that?

They REALLY wanted that fucking ship though, so they all sent themselves through the anomaly. They sent their last 100 ships into it, and only a few survived, unsure of when and where they’d end up.

“Why did your progeny betray you?” “She met a boy”. YEAH, THAT’S WHY. NOT YOU BEING A SHIT-ASS DAD.

We get Jankom Pog’s backstory. He was on a cryosleep ship, and was the only person who the malfunctioning AI woke up. It keeps asking him for his name and query, and it eventually turns into a bit of a tick, where he just says his name. He eventually sends himself out of an escape pod so that the other crewmembers could survive, and is captured by slavers.

Janeway researches the kids too, and is like “These are run away slaves, and they’re just kids. They’re not CRIMINALS. Clearly we’re wrong about something and just scared them.” THERE SHE IS, GOOD JOB. She goes to ask the Diviner what’s up, walks in on their little party, and is knocked out.

Ghost in the Machine - PRO 8/10

The kids are trying to use the holodeck to figure out how to communicate with Janeway without communicating with her. This fails. They go to enjoy an icecream party, but then some weird shit happens, and they realize they’re still stuck in the holodeck. Oh boy, malfunctioning holodeck episode!

They get stuck in a few of their hologames. First Zero’s, which is a mystery game holonovel.

The holonovel suddenly shifts into a streetfighter hologame that Jankom plays to unwind. This is where they find out the safeties are off, and that’s bad. “When the safeties are on, nothing hurts you!” Uh, O’Brien broke his fucking shoulder.

Aaaand then it shifts to a black and white and noir. Animation is a great vehicle for Star Trek.

It’s Murf’s holo program. “He’s singing!” “Or he’s lipsincing very convincingly.” That’s so fun.

Dal’s program is a pirate program where he’s captain. Set sail for one piece! It combines with Rok’s, which is an animal vet sim.

Turns out the holodeck was a ruse set up by… HOLO JANEWAY! Dun dun dun! She was hacked by the weapon to send the ship to Federation space. While they were in there, Janeway hacked the ship and sent it out of the neutral zone, locking them out. Then her mind was wiped, she has NO recollection of it at all. Fucking horrifying. She’s REALLY freaked out by this, understandably.

Mindwalk - PRO 8/10

They go RIGHT to the Dauntlet, but the ship makes itself run away. The Admiral is currently knocked out, they have no way to communicate, and they’re running out of time. Either the ship blows up the admiral’s, or gets to Starfleet and blows up Starleet. They need to communicate somehow. So Dal and Zero connect their thoughts together and telepathically try to speak to the Admiral. It goes wrong, of course.

THEY SWAP MINDS. AND KEEP THEIR ORIGINAL VOICES! :D Kate Mulgrew flexes like CRAZY here, pretending to be a teen in her body. Dal pretending to be Janeway is VERY funny. “Hello! Starfleet… person!!!” Imagine if you’re fucking Admiral said that to you. “Attention, sir, I’ve found the Admiral, and she’s like, really, REALLY drunk.” SHE DOUBLE FINGER GUNS. THAT’S SO FUNNY.

“As your doctor, I ORDER you to drink this coffee”. LMFAO.

Janeway (in Dal) talks to Holo Janeway. They show this by letting her be Janeway’s body and voice for now, which is good. I love animation.

THEY FUCKING REFERENCE THRESHOLD. HOLY SHIT.

They communicate with Dal in the other ship through charades, which is cute. They need thgem to fly out of the ship and touch each other to reset their brains. Unfortunately, Dal in Janeway is captured and knocked out cause like, yeah, she’s clearly not herself.

The Diviner breaks Dal Janeway out, because “you saved my life, now I will save your’s”. Fascinating.

They need to create a conduit. That could either be touch… or a phaser shot. So Janeway Dal shoots her own body, as it’s being tractored in. Cool. Unfortunately, they do not trust Janeway anymore and immediately brig her.

They make it to Federation space, aaaand… it’s a bunch of Federation ships waiting for them. Uh oh. lol remember in Picard season 1 when they just copy pasted the same ship over and over?

Supernova Part 1 - PRO 8/10

The Protostar needs to boost around a field of Federation ships, avoiding phaser fire, as they try to get a way out of there. We get a big sexy space battle, that’s fun.

Janeway is freed by someone who is alive THANKS for Janeway, from that one episode where Janeway risked everyone’s lives to let the Brenari escape in a wormhole. Cute.

Gwyn is gonna tell Dal that he’s not allowed in Starfleet cause he’s an augment. She’s like “I need to tell you something” and he kisses her, thinking it’s a big romantic moment. It is not. Whoops. He takes this to be like “Okay, I have the least the lose. Time to fire on the Federation as they board the ship.”

The big evil robot keeps everyone at bay… except Murf, who kicks his ass. Meanwhile, Ascensia, the secret evil lady, is fighting Gwyn on the bridge. The Diviner tries to stop her from killing Gwyn, and is stabbed, as she accept hails… and sends out the virus code. Whoops, GG bad guy.

But the kids aren’t done yet. They work together to free themselves, and stop them. They burst onto the bridge… just in time to see the Diviner die in Gwyndala’s arms and fade into dust. Some people

The evil code breaks everyone’s translators. But you know who speaks every language?

Dal just… makes Gwyn captain. I mean, I think she should have been captain all show, but it happened kinda randomly. But yay! She sends distress beacons to any ships in range: “PLEASE COME HELP US, NON-FEDERATION ALLIES”. The Klingons seem to ignore them. We then get scenes of a lot of Federation ships being fired upon, and I just know a LOT of people are dying just off screen. Thanks to this episode, this kids show might have one of the highest kill counts of any Trek show. This is Wolf 359-2.

The Klingons are here to help after all, here to beam out survivors. LOTS of Non-Federations show up. Even a Gorn ship! But it’s not enough. More Federation ships beam in to help, and are trapped in the fly trap. There’s not enough allies in the sector to help.

Supernova Part 2 - PRO 9/10

They need to stop the flytrap, but how? Well, the only way is to blow up the entire Protostar. But if they blow it up, the protostar will blow up EVERYTHING. Rok theorizes if they blow it up AT warp, it’ll spread out the explosion across spacetime. Fair enough? But they need someone to stay back. At first, it’s Dal who decides to, but Holo JAneway stays behind instead. She’s “just a hologram”. But she makes a copy of herself on an isolinear chip so they can bring her with them. That’s not existentially horrifying!

….Turns out her program is too big for the chip, so she just… lies and says she copied herself so she can sacrifice herself. Damn, that’s sad as hell.

We get a long scene of sad music as they escape, the protostar blasts off, and explodes. Goodbye, Holo Janeway. This shuts down the viral code, saving everyone.

She left behind a message, telling them how much she cared for them. It’s quite emotional.

They’re lost floating in space, but now we go to Starfleet. The Protostar’s explosion made a rift in space, to where Chakotay is stranded in the future, so they plan to go and rescue him… but not before the kids make it to Starfleet, somehow!

They’re put on trial for stealing the Protostar (I still argue they didn’t steal shit), and Janeway defends them. They succeed. Everyone gets in, and is put under Janeway’s command… except Gwyn. She’s not staying. She’s going back to her home planet to try and help save them.

This time we get a PROPER go to kiss. I didn’t think this romance was really needed, but it’s fine.

They get a new ship, another Protostar ship, and blast off to find Chakotay. Oh, Zero gets a new robo body btw. He’s built by Apple now.

….end of season 1! This was a good show. No 10/10 episodes or anything but like, it was really enjoyable over all.

entry.title: Retro Achievement Mastery 230 - My QLDC Level

link.title: Retro Achievement Mastery 230 - My QLDC Level

entry.content:
So, I used to be big into romhacking. I got into it in the early 2000s, on a website called ACMLM’s Board, and still occasionally hack stuff to this day. My main game is Super Mario World, which is funny cause like, I don’t actually like SMW that much. I’ve made a few hacks. But the things you can do with SMW are NUTS. It’s fully open to do anything. I always say you can do anything you want in this game.

There’s a whole community for SMW hacking. It’s called Super Mario World Central, and they put on romhacking contests every few months. One such contest is QLDC, or the Questionable Level Design Contest. Originally called the Awful Level Design Contest, they decided to change it because playing intentionally bad shit is unpleasant, but playing WEIRD shit is fun. This is a contest for weird, unique ideas that might be a little strange and hard to grasp, but can still be fun.

They’re not always fun or good. But this one is. This is one of the best ones submitted ever for the contest. This is called “My QLDC Level”, and is by Faro and MM102.

So, you’ve played SMW, right? You have side scrolling levels interspersed by the world map. But what if the game… WAS the world map? Well, you can move in all the directions of the path on the world map, and we can also probably add a button for a run. But is that a game worth playing?

Turns out, yes! It goes without saying this turns SMW into a completely seperate game. It’s very unique and fun. It’s a collection of mostly single screen rooms with little puzzles and timing mechanics to move back and forth between the world map poimts and get to the end, or “the level”. There’s a level promised at the end of this, and lemme tell you, it is worth it.

In the end, this is one of the best SMW hacks. It’s quite short, there’s an achievement for beating it in seven and a half minutes. But size don’t matter. It’s a questionable, but creative little hack.

entry.title: LizstarTrek - Prodigy Season 1 Episodes 1 - 10
entry.content:
Every Sunday my Twitch subs and I watch Star Trek in my Discord. Here are my reviews and thoughts on each of the episodes as I see it. If you’re curious about a nerd’s views on Star Trek episodes, please read on, I go quite in depth with some of these episodes! I’ve watched some Star Trek before but not all of it!

This is an interesting one. Fully 3D animated, so the third animated Trek show, and Trek does quite well in animation, though it’s never been 3D. This one is ALSO… for kids! That’s not a bad thing. Some of the best shows of all time are for kids. I don’t expect this to be like, Avatar or Gravity Falls levels, but I expect this to be the real last bright spot in the Trek ouvre.

Lost and Found - PRO 7.5/10

We start by seeing Dal R’El, our hero, stuck on a prison colony. He can’t communicate with anyone else because translators were banned. He’s watched over by big scary robots, who ask him if he’s seen “fugitive zero”. He has. They are gonna torture it out of him, but then fugitive zero does a big splosion and Dal R’El tries to escape in the progress in a big exciting escape scene whiiiich ends in failure, whoopsies.

We then get the big bad robot working with some girl who communicates with a Kazon. Ooh, Delta Quadrant stuff, huh? She’s the daughter of someone important here, “The Diviner”, though seems to be just being used by him. She has to translate for them, and slave trades some cute cat creature. She’s pissed that it’s a kid, and tells off the Kazon. This gets her in kind of hot water with the superbot and her dad, though he lets her off the hook. He’s also worried about the Federation for some reason, which is interesting since they’re so fucking far away.

Dal is given a chance to escape. The “progeny”, Gweyn, will get him off this rock if he can tell her how to find “Fugitive Zero”, who is a Medusan. Medusans were in the TOS episode “Is There In Truth No Beauty?”, which is a WILD callback, that’s not even a very important episode. They’re a telepathic species that drives people mad.

There’s also lots of stuff about Dal not knowing who or what he is. Apparently that’s a point of angst for him, not knowing his species. I don’t see why that matters that much but I guess I have a different opinion on that kinda stuff.

While mining and looking for Fugitive X, Dal and a big rocky friend he makes enemies with crash into a cave and find a hidden Federation ship just… sitting there. As soon as the ship activates, they can actually communicate. The rocky friend is actually a girl, and a kid, her name is Rak-tak.

Zero shows up and now that they have a BETTER way off this rock, they’ll all work together, they just need an engineer to fix it. So they get a Tellarite Engineer named Jankom Pog. God, that cannot be his name. He’s poggers, is he?

Rok invites someone she always liked and wanted to communicate with. A cute little slug being. She wanted to know what he’s like! He is… not intelligent. That’s cute. Pet Slug! His name is Murf :3

Since Dal couldn’t find Zero (he doesn’t rat them out), he’s thrown onto the surface, which is very dangerous and no one survives who’s sent there. Gwyn is unhappy he’s sent up there but can’t do anything about it. So it’ll be super hard for him to escape right? Actually it’ll be super easy. Barely an inconvenience. Gwyn helps him escape so that he can lead them to Zero.

What results is a giant battle. They need to escape in the ship while trying to kidnap Gwyn and hold her hostage as a bargaining chip. The ship, “the protostar” as the Diviner calls it, is almost destroyed in the battle but then blasts off.

Dal has to have one last big climactic battle with the big evil robot Drednok who is TOTALLY not General Greivous. I’mma be real, getting BIG Star Wars Clone Wars vibes from this show already. That’s not a bad thing.

The day is saved by Murf pressing the phaser button. He’s a non sapient weapons specialist :D

They make it out and into space! “Okay so where are we going?” “I have no idea.” And then the ship for some reason FINALLY activates his hologram.

Hologram Janeway is here. I guess if it’s gonna be a Delta Quadrant show she should be here?

For a pilot of Trke, this is up there. Its pacing is a bit weird but hey, it’s alright!

Star Struck - PRO 6/10

Janeway gives them a crash course on what the Federation is. Everyone is super into it, but Dal is not. He thinks the Federation won’t do anything to help them, they’re just fugitives in a stolen ship anyway. I mean, the Federation is basically just the Borg, right? Anyways, now it’s THEIR ship, and Dal claims to be captain.

A few character things here. Dal lies a LOT. Rok hates lying. Gwyn wants to be a part of this but is y’know, dealing with the programming of her father.

“I appreciate a gal who knows what she likes” says Kate Mulgrew, as every woman watching this melts into a pile of goo that could rival Murf.

This kids got a lot of growing to do. I don’t like him very much yet, but I do like everyone else. Obviously he’ll get better. His stupid hard headedness makes him do stupid stuff that deactivates power. Of course, this releases Gwyn, and Rok has to go try and recapture her. We get a cool exciting fight scene where they fight in the middle of a ship as it’s being replicated. Almost like animation is a great medium for Trek!

Shit is bad and they’re about to die, so Dal gets his head out of his ass and admits he needs help. Janeway fixes everything.

Janeway gives a good speech about how the Federation didn’t come out fully formed. People need to learn to work together for a better future. It’s cute.

Also the Diviner is chasing after them in what I can only describe as a Reaper from Mass Effect. It’s like they hollowed out a Crystalline Entity and painted it black and red. It’s so amazingly obviously evil.

Dream Catcher - PRO 7/10

Janeway tells them of an M-Class planet nearby and that they need to explore it. It’s in the Hirogen system. Oh god, this is gonna end with a Hirogen skinning Murf.

They keep lying and pretending their cadets, and I think it’s kinda obvious Janeway is just humoring them. She’s a Trek hologram, she’s pretty smart.

They go out for a walk on the planet, taking the Mako. Somewhere, Picard salivates at this thing. They all IMMEDIATELY split up. This is gonna be another “we gotta learn to work together as a team” type episode. It’s honestly wild to make a show like this in Trek, where we know people die all the time from unsafe and mistakes. And they are being VERY unsafe. Obviously no children are gonna be killed, but y’know.

Gwyn breaks out and takes control of the ship EXTREMELY easily. She’s kind to Murf, which is good. Murf is our boy

We get some seperate stories. Pog finds a house and steals some soup. Rok finds some cute animals that clearly want to eat her, but she’s a rock. Zero is scanning for samples.

Dal meets some psychic root people that want him to stay so they can give him all he’d ever want. They are creepy and scary and represent themselves with Janeway. All this to eat them. Only Dal and Gwyn notice that these psychic hallucinations are real. Dal, because Janeway said she can’t leave the ship, and Gwyn because its her deepest desire. Her dad tellins her he’s proud of her, which he’d NEVER fucking do.

Gwyn tries to take off, and the Protostar crashes. She manages to escape in the shuttle, rescuing Murf, but now they’re all stranded.

Terror Firma - PRO 8.5/10

They have 10km to walk to get back to the ship, and Gwyn has injured herself, but she uses her weird metal shaping powers to make herself a cast. Dal is very cross with her. She’s OBVIOUSLY a good person and I can’t wait for this show to get past this point so she can join the crew properly. Y’know, in the same way I couldn’t wait for Catra to stop being programmed and kiss She-ra.

Especially since she’s like, the only competent one on the crew. She sets the planet on fire and they manage to escape as it tries to eat them. It had been tricking them by terraforming itself so they’d get lost. They hide in a fallen Klingon ship. Apparently the Klingons made it far out here. Dal and Gwyn have a moment together, and they decide to use the stars to navigate to the ship.

The bad guys show up, and Gwyn FINALLY betrays them to save the others.

This is some Lord of the Rings Nazgul-ass shit.

Dal leaves Gwyn behind because even if she saved them now, she’s the one who called htem here, so she “made her choice”. Aaand then the Diviner shows up, sees her dying, and is like “oh hey, sorry, but I gotta go to that ship” and goes to take the Protostar. ….Except it’s not real, it’s the fucking vines. lol fuck you buddy. The show has a good fakeout about this.

The others make it to the ship, then save Gwyn.

Dog, it was that or die, what the fuck did you expect

He tells her to “do the right thing”. She does. She engages The Protostar. Not the ship, but the protostar that’s inside the engine. They have a star inside the ship, which has a unique kind of warp, and BOOM off they go.

I liked that final scene. I think I’mma like Gwyn a lot.

Terror Firma - PRO 8/10

The proto star sent them 400 light years away. They’re safe, for now, but the proto star shuts down and they don’t know when the Diviner will be back…. so the others band together to ask Ral to go to the Federation.

RAL IS PLAYING THE GAME. JESUS CHRIST.

They go chasing after Murf for his vote, and find him in the holodeck. They discover the Koboyashi Maru in the list, and Janeway tells them it’s a test for the best Starship captains and basically eggs him into doing it. I hope this ends with him realizing he is NOT captain material, and Gwyn becomes captain instead.

Gwyn is too busy being a sadsack though. She feels she doesn’t belong anywhere. Zero talks to her and picks her up. I like Zero.

Meanwhile the Diviner makes a new Gwyn. She’s a clone of him. If Gwyn is a clone of the Diviner… does that mean she’s trans?????

The Koboyashi Maru gives them some legendary heroes. Uhura, Crusher, Odo, and Spock. Everyone but Crusher is voiced by voice lines spliced from old shows. That’s actually fantastic. Amazing solution. The episode is even dedicated to them! Anyways he fucks up bad and is given a very low rating. So he tries it again, over and over. Eventually he gets pissy and kicks Jankom off his crew to be replaced by Scotty.

Murf is a perfect creature. I would die for Murf.

It’s me.

Spock gives Dal some advice through spliced voice lines, and it’s cute.

Meanwhile, they hack the Protostar and get some of the old hidden files. they find…

THE RETURN OF CHOKIE.

First Con-tact - PRO 7/10

They discover the transporter and do tests with it. They need a living test subject, and teleport Murf. MURF, NO!! They’re gonna fucking inside-out Murf. No, he’s just sliding down the front of the ship. What a cold open.

They get a distress call from a poor old crone who’s ship is on fire and needs people to save the orphans. Dal recognizes her as the Ferengi who raised him. They go to visit, she’s so happy to see him. She’s like “I’ve been looking for you for years!” she’s also… VERY obviously untrustworthy. She totally sold him to slavery. She needs some things from a pre-space civilization, and she’ll give them a cloaking device they need to hide.

So it’s time for the “let’s learn about the prime directive” episode!

Ah, there it is.

They successfully make first contact, with Gwyn discovering how htey communicate through resonance. She should be captain, she’s the only person here captable except for Zero, and I don’t think they’d want it.

It’s a species you’d see in Metroid Prime :o

Anyways the aliens gift them… a song :) It’s beautiful and all the crew like it. But the Ferengi is like “fuck that that’s not what I want” and steals their crystals.

Anyways yes, obviously she’s evil and sold him into slavery. She also steals stuff from their ship and leaves in her cloaked ship. With some trickery, they get the crystal back, but obviously they fucked up in many ways. Janeway is NOT happy. They lost supplies, they did seriouis harm to the development of this species, and Dal is real depressed cause his mommy is evil ): Gwyn can relate.

First Con-tact - PRO 7/10

Janeway needs to try and get them together, so she makes a wheat/chicken/fox puzzle, aaand it goes poorly too. Dal freaks out and comes clean about how they stole the ship and aren’t a real crew.

Meanwhile, now that they learn where the ship is, the Diviner hacks their systems to create a robot to hunt them.

A Tachyon storm causes a temporal blast, which seems to rip Janeway into multiple pieces. They all appear to be in seperate timelines or universes of some kind. Jankom’s explodes and he dies. rip.

Janeway finds herself in another temporal phase with Rok, and figures out what’s going on. Everyone IS on the same ship, but is just in a different temporal phase. For Rok, it’s going very slow. For Jankom, is moved VERY fast. Janeway tries to get Rok to stop the warpcore breach, but she panics and turns her off. At least Zero is ACTUALLY competent and fixes the problem, giving the solution to Janeway so she can pass it to the next person. Whoever the next person is will have to save us all- oh it’s Murf. Fuck. It’s okay Murf, we don’t blame you.

It’s Dal’s time, but he’s still a sad sack. Janeway gives him a pep talk about Apollo 13. Cute. He still fails, but at least his failure will pave the way for learning how to fix it in the future.

Dreadnok is fully built on the ship in Gwyn’s time, and fucking deletes Holo Janeway. He uses Chakotay’s command codes. Of COURSE he didn’t voice lock them. Gwyn blows him out of the airlock, but that blows out the thing they were using the fix the engines aaaand it blows up, too.

They have one last hope. Rok is still alive! She gets a message from Gwyn’s time, about how they all bnelieve in her, and not to doubt herself. She rebuilds the coupler, and also rebuilds Janeway while she’s at it. Thankfully time is moving so slow. Very slow. Very, very VERY slow. She was in there for… “too long”. She studied a lot.

Then we get a fun cliffhanger… Drednok is still out there! Dun dun dunnnn.

A Moral Star Part 1 - PRO 7/10

Drednok’s remains deliver an ultimatum: If they do not return the Protostar, he’s going to kill all of his slaves. They can either go back to the prison and TRY to save them, probably fail, or possibly trust the Diviner which they totally cannot. Orrr jump to the Federation, hoping they can jump fast enough to save them, but probably not.

Everyone is down to go except Dal. He’s scared. He doesn’t trust that he can do this correctly, but he has his friends to help prepare plans. We get a cute montage of them working together to come up with a plan.

They get cadet uniforms and blast off. As Janeway says, they are doing a dangerous mission and risking themselves to save others. They’ve earned Starfleet. It’s a cute moment.

They are tractor beam’d in, but they have a plan. It goes a little out the window as the terms change and he demands Gwyn too. Of course, she sacrifices herself for the others “to make it right” for not doing anything to help them sooner.

GOTH MOMMY JANEWAY.

Surprise, a guy who does child slave trading betrays them and blows up their engines, killing their power, gravity, and eventually oxygen.

lol it’s all been a trap. They knew it’d go like this. Zero was actually Murf in a fake Zero, and Murf is fucking EATING the protostar. MURF ATE A STAR. I love you Murf.

They just hope they have time to do the rest of their plan.

A Moral Star Part 2 - PRO 8.5/10

The miners can now talk. Two of them are gay. I was gonna make a joke about them but then they just fucking did it. They out-joked me!!!

Rok and Jankom are trying to fix the ship, while Zero and Dal are trying to get all the miners ready to get on the ship and escape. They turn everyone’s ankle bracelets into translators.

The miners rebel and immediately kill Drednok, the cat child fucking decapitates him. But not before he transmits Murf’s coordinates and the protocore is transported. You’d tihnk he could just scan for the massive energy signature but maybe Murf dampens it.

We then get a sickass scene where, turns out goth mommy Janeway was upgraded to resist the overrides, and fucking beats the shit out of the Diviner. Unfortunately, the Diviner convinces Gwyn to stop by saying he’ll “tell her the truth”. I don’t care WHAT he’s doing, even if it’s “saving our people”, child slavery kills every possible chance at you being a good guy.

He shows her a holodeck program of what happens to their home planet. Currently, it’s fine. He was sent back in time to stop them. According to him, Starfleet did this. First contact caused a civil war and they all killed each other. So his plan is to go to Starfleet and kill them all. He set up a bomb on the ship to blow up if they ever go to Starfleet. You’d think there’d be a few other options, but nope. Genocide. Thankfully Gwyn realizes how fucking shitty this is immediately.

This is a good line.

Dal beams onboard the ship to try and save Gwyn, buuuut immediately fails. Good thing Zero is also there to…. do this.

The Diviner used Zero as a weapon to drive others mad. Now it’s his turn. He’s stopped, but not before Gwyn sees Zero in the reflection of his combadge. She’s mad ): That’s sad.

They banish the Diviner to the jail planet. So uh, he’s dead, right? He’s insane and stuck on a planet by himself, he’s fucked. That’s just killing him.

With a little bit of medicine, she’s fixed, but forgets the events of what happened. That sucks, cause now she forgot about the bomb. Gwyn is a little apprehensive of heading to Starfleet, but off they go, with a little cute monologue by Janeway.

Their signature is picked up. Janeway is on her way.

This isn’t the end of the season, but like, it had a mini-hiatus and is very season finale feeling.

Over all? Very good! Good characters and plot. The animation feels like a Gamecube game sometimes but thats fine. Thats almost a GOOD thing to me. Excited for more!

entry.title: X-Men Deep Dive Readalong 3 - Issues 41 - 45
entry.content:
I’m reading every X-Men comic. This was a mistake. This will continue to be a mistake. But when have mistakes ever stopped me? Come hang out for some reviews of mid-tier 60s comics!

X-Men #41 - February 1968 3/10

This is a weird one. The X-Men are on a train that’s suddenly attacked by a weird lookin’ hulkin’ guy. They fight him but he easily shrugs off all their attacks, because that’s always how this comic works, the X-Men just get the shit kicked out of them constantly. They name this guy and he happily takes that as his new name.

He is “Grotesk the sub-human”, a prince of some ancient civilization that lived in caves below the surface. Everyone he loves died and he got mutated by I THINK atomic blasts from above? And now he wants revenge. Honestly, I’m on this guy’s side??

Actually he apparently wants nukes so he can blow up the Earth entirely. I dunno, that feels like going a LITTLE far. The X-Men show up again to stop him, aaaaand to be continued

We’re still doing really short issues causae we have the mini stories in the back. This one has Jack o’Diamonds, who met Scott and went “Hey you’re my minion now”, demanding Scott murder Xavier. Scott’s like “what the fuck? No?” so Jack goes and pushes himself into some radiation machine which turns him into pure diamond, and he calls himself The Living Diamond. This guy’s got like three names!

X-Men #42 - March 1968 3/10

This is such a funny cover. Anyways WOAH, SENSATIONALISM, PROFESSOR X IS GONNA DIE FOR THE FIRST TIME FOR REAL HE’S REALLY GONNA DIE HE’S GONNA DIE OMG HE’S GONNA DIE WOW

Anyways Xavier is being kinda weird. Scott and Beast are fighting Grotesk and getting his ass kicked and Xavier is refusing to let the rest of them go help. Jean is siding with him, everyone else is like “what the hell???”

Scott and Beast, of course, get beat up by Grotesk, who just… leaves.

Everyone wants to confront Xavier for being a dickhead, and Jean is holding them back. Did I mention the weird costume change btw? I dunno if I like it much. but then Xavier is like “actually no please help me” because he’s being murdered by Grotesk for some reason. Xavier led him there to try and lay a trap but uh, told no one about this.

They manage to defeat Grotesk, or really Xavier does, (actually the machine he’s trying to steal blows up and kills him) and then he admits that he was actually dying of a completely different disease, but set this all up to stop Grotesk. And then he just, dies.

Or so he claims. You already did this in like, issue 4, can I really trust you??

More backstory, Living Diamond is attacking Xavier now, and Scott sides with him cause he’s not a raging murderer made out of actual diamonds.

They use a radiation machine to make him EVEN MORE diamond, but he’s already pure diamond, so he just fucking explodes. Scott just killed a man. Scott then joins Xavier as his first X-Man and gets his outfit and visor.

X-Men #43 - April 1968 3.5/10

Another incredible Magneto face.

Magnetos back I guess. Apparently this happened in some other comics, maybe Avengers?

Quicksilver attends Xavier’s funeral, and everyone is bothered by it, because they hate him again. Apaprently Quicksilver and Scarlet Witch denounced humanity and joined with Magneto again? Man, they just… cannot make good decisions. He runs away.

Xavier left them a VHS tape with his last will, and it’s basically “yo, Magneto is back, take him out”.

….Man the incest vibes are REAL rough with these two. Anyways Scarlet Witch seems to be sick, her powers are gone, and Pietro WANTED to get Xavier to cure her, but now he’s dead, soooo. He calls Xavier “our only friend”, which is fucking wild, they were never on the same side or even really interracted. Anyways Magneto is claiming to create a device to cure Wanda but obviously he won’t, but they gotta stick around just incase.

Magneto steals a boat, and the X-Men show up aaaand get their asses kicked. To be continued???

Our bonus this issue is about Scott. Again. It’s about his powers, and goes into more depth. Apparently they are solar powered (I cannot WAIT for the punch dimension). It explains how he uses his visor without touching it (button in his glove), etc etc. It’s alright.

X-Men #44 - May 1968 4/10

Angel centric issue this time.

The X-Men are captured by Magneto, who continues to not kill anyone cause that’d be mean. Angel manages to break out and has to flee and look for help. Quicksilver, who can fly I guess, chases after but fails to catch him in time, somehow.

Angel goes off into the ocean and into a storm, as an island forms out of the ocean. He explores the ocean and finds some red flying guy who attacks Angel

This guy is Red Raven. They fight for a page before Raven goes “wait, why am I doing this I don’t want to hurt you” and stops. He explains he just wants to stop people from finding this island. Years ago, his people lived here, and they were going to invade the planet and conquer the Humans, but he was like “that’s rude >:(“ and gasses them all and puts them in cryo tubes. Now he must keep watch, as they will awake every 20 years as the island rises above the surface. Angel is like “hey isn’t it kinda bad to betray all your people?” “Maybe you’re right… ah, no, you’re not, bye” and then Raven kicks Angel out and the island sinks. The end.

This feels like a filler episode but it wasn’t… bad?

We get Bobby Backstory this time! Bobby is out with his girlfriend when those Roving Gangs Of Bullies that always exist in comics like this attack him and try to assault her. He freezes them, and then everyone is like “Holy shit, someone to be racist towards!” and hate him for ANOTHER reason now. Also his girlfriend says he’s a freak and runs away.

A mob comes and drags him away for using powers on someone, and not actually hurting them. Oh… no? Really they just want to be bigots. The comic is going harder into this now. Gosh, when did the X-Men get woke- oh wait. Anyways, Xavier and Scott read the news and go to save him, to be continued

X-Men #45 - June 1968 4.5/10

Angel continues to try and go get help, specifically the Avengers, as Cyclops manages to burst out of his jail. He finds Jean who’s unconscious and is like “welp she’s useless”, wandering around as he bumbles into, first Toad and secondly Quicksilver. Quicksilver is a weirdly complicated character for this era, as a villain who has no actual interest in doing evil things, and is like “hey we don’t gotta fight” but Cyclops punches at him anyway cause fuck you, Quicksilver!

Quicksilver thinks all mutants should be allied together to fight against the Homosapien menace. Man, THIS is where all that came from??? This is wild, this is Magneto’s whole fucking thing in the X-Men media I’ve actually seen. In this, Magneto couldn’t care less, he just wants to rule over other people. It’s actually really interesting the path this concept takes. It goes from being the character trait of a sympathetic anti-villain to the character trait of a straight up villain (Magneto) to the character trait of a sympathetic anti-villain (Magneto, again, but written better).

Anyways Cyclops knocks out Quicksilver and is worried he actually hurt him, wheeen the Avenger show up, see Cyclops beating up their friend, and turn on him. Ohhh boy, MORE OF MY FAVORITE, FORCED REASONS FOR HEROES TO FIGHT…. and it’s not even in the next X-Men issue!!! Weird. It’s actually in Avengers #53.

In the backstory, Cyclops comes to break Bobby out of jail, but he’s like “No, I trust the system to give me a fair trial” as the hicks outside his jail cell go “ohhh boy, can’t wait to do a good ol’ fashioned lynchin’!”

Cyclops tries to FORCE him to leave, which just makes shit look worse. Now they’re like “oh I guess now we’re JUSTIFIED in killing them”. Bobby beats up Cyclops as the mob turns on both of them.

Avengers #53 - June 1968 2.5/10

We’re doin’ this again. The Avengers see their friend being attacked by Cyclops, ignore the fact that Quicksilver literally denounced Humanity openly and is working with a villain very obviously, we need a reason to fight so we fight.

Cyclops thinks they might be… robots?? Okay, sure. We’re got Hawkeye, Goliath, Wasp, and the recently introduced Black Panther. They all gang up on Cyclops, who somehow holds them off even though he gets his ass kicked by villains of the week all the time and he JUST fought Quicksilver AND broke out of his bindings. Dude should be spent.

Angel shows back up and they start to split off. Meanwhile Megneto and his cronies watch happily, cause this is perfectly fine. Eventually of course they realize that this is all bullshit and fight Magneto instead. Toad betrays Magneto, sick of his bullshit, and sets the base to explode as he, Scarlet Witch, and Quicksilver dip. Once again, Magneto is defeated by his own Assholish behavior.

Magneto is blown up and seemingly dies. Quicksilver and Wanda don’t even talk to the Avengers ONCE in this. What the fuck?
entry.summary: I’m reading every X-Men comic. This was a mistake. This will continue to be a mistake. But when have mistakes ever stopped me? Come hang out for some reviews of mid-tier 60s comics!
